name: Stage
description: Base class for a stage. An application subclasses it as OGX.Stages.Name and lists that class in app.json vapps.
access: Define require('Stages.Name', 'Stage') and OGX.Stages.Name, then construct(this, 'Stages.Name'). app.json addresses the instance as selector:Stages.Name under vapps. A route does not use a Stage node as its root. Method names are not OML keys.

properties.name: template
properties.description: Template name. The wiki example uses Stage. Optional.

properties.name: use
properties.description: Present on the wiki stage example as true. That page does not describe the key. Optional.

properties.name: anim
properties.description: Transition when switching stages. false, swap, or flip. If both stages set anim, each plays its own. Optional.

catalog_status: Listed fields are OML config from the OGX.JS wiki. Methods are not listed. Use inherited true for documented base classes. Do not invent members that are absent.
